subject: Proposed MAP & evaluation plan — commercial terms and discount request (Helios AI)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver@heliosai.com>, Helios Procurement <procurement@heliosai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP & evaluation plan — commercial terms and discount request (Helios AI)

Hi Oliver / team,

Thanks again for the discussion yesterday — great alignment on the evaluation objectives. Attached is a first draft of a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) aligned to the pilot and a suggested commercial structure. High-level ask: if HeliosAI can commit to a 12-month term with the milestone ramp below, we can offer a tiered introductory discount for year one.

Attachments: Helios_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP with milestone dates), Deal_Deck_v3.pdf

Proposed MAP highlights (summary):
- Milestone 1 (Pilot start, 2 weeks): integration + baseline eval — target 5k tokens/day
- Milestone 2 (Pilot completion, week 6): quality gates met on eval prompts; ramp to 20k tokens/day
- Milestone 3 (Production rollout, month 3): 50% of inference traffic on Redwood; SLA agreed
- Commercial: 12-month contract. Tiered FY1 discount: 30% off list for months 1–4 contingent on signed commitment and milestone 2 acceptance; 15% months 5–12 as ramp validation.
- Payment: Net 30 preferred.

Please review and let me know if the discount structure is acceptable as a starting point. If it is, I will request internal approvals (finance/CFO/CEO) and share a redline with legal.

Next steps:
1) Confirm MAP dates and ramp targets by EOD Thu 6/3
2) If acceptable, we’ll escalate for approval to finalize the commercial (I’ll copy finance/CFO/CEO as needed)

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn@redwood.ai | M: (415) 555-0198

--- Attachment stub: Helios_MAP_v1.pdf (map outline, 3 pages)
--- Attachment stub: Deal_Deck_v3.pdf (customer-facing slides, 12 pages)

Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & evaluation plan — commercial terms and discount request (Helios AI)

Evelyn,

Thanks — the MAP looks productive. A few quick clarifications before we sign a pilot SOW:
- Can you confirm the milestone acceptance criteria for Milestone 2 (what metrics do you need us to hit?)
- We typically need Net 30 or Net 45 payment terms for pilots. Is Net 30 ok?
- The 30% introductory discount is attractive — can you confirm whether that is a one-time concession or applied across usage tiers?

We’re also going to share the MAP with our legal and procurement team (cc’d). If we can get the pilot start in the first full week of July, that would be ideal.

—Oliver

Team — forwarding Helios’ reply. Key commercial point: Helios is asking for a 30% introductory discount tied to acceptance of Milestone 2 and a 12-mo term. They prefer Net 30.

Why I’m escalating: 30% FY1 off list is outside the standard deal guardrails for this segment. We can trade the concession for a binding 12-month commitment + guaranteed ramp (production ramp to 50% traffic by month 3) and require an executive sponsor on their side.

Ask:
- Marcus / finance: can you run the unit economics on a 30% FY1 concession with the proposed ramp / commit?
- Naomi: would you be comfortable signing off if finance signs off, or do you want this to go to Vivek for final approval?

Attachments: Helios_Redlines.docx (placeholder) — customer redlines incoming from legal. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/3742

I’ll hold off on counter-offer to Helios until we hear back internally.

Evelyn

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Helios MAP — customer asking for 30% intro discount (need finance/CFO review)

Evelyn / team — reviewed the ask. Quick take:
- Up to 20% FY1 can be approved by finance for a committed 12-month term, provided we materially push the ramp milestones (proof of usage and acceptance by month 2, with penalty/rebate language if ramp misses).
- 30% is outside finance auto-approval band and will need exec sign-off (CFO at a minimum; >25% we typically take to Vivek for visibility).

Conditions we’d require for any concession:
1) Signed 12-month MSA + SOW with explicit ramp milestones and acceptance criteria (metrics: latency within X ms, eval pass rate >= 92%, error rate < 0.5%)
2) Payment terms Net 30 (we can accept)
3) Revenue recognition schedule and clawback if ramp targets not met (simple rebate structure)

I’ll prepare a short deck on the economics and run the numbers — target to have finance recs by tomorrow EOD. If we move forward with 30% ask, Naomi will need to sign off and decide whether to raise to Vivek.

-Marcus
Director, Finance
marcus@redwood.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Helios AI — request for 30% FY1 discount (need CEO sign-off?)

Vivek — quick summary: Helios (strategic POC in retail AI vertical) is requesting a 30% introductory discount in FY1 in exchange for a 12-month commitment and the MAP milestones outlined. Finance can support up to 20% with strict ramp/clawback language. 30% materially affects initial ARR and lifetime unit economics but may be justified for a strategic win in this space.

Options:
A) Approve 30% now with conditions: binding ramp milestones, executive sponsor, and a rebate if ramp misses (structed clawback).
B) Approve 20% now under finance guardrails; offer an additional one-time credit if the customer hits accelerated ramp (performance milestone).

We need a quick decision so we can respond to procurement/legal — they want a pilot SOW and pricing confirmation by EOD tomorrow.

If you approve A, please confirm and I’ll instruct legal to prepare the SOW and finance to prepare the rebate schedule.

- Naomi
CFO, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai

All — after reviewing the context, I’m inclined to approve option A (approve 30% FY1) given Helios is strategically valuable in the retail vertical and the MAP provides an enforceable ramp. Conditions for the approval:
1) 12-month minimum commitment signed prior to discount taking effect
2) Milestone acceptance criteria codified in the SOW (Marcus / Legal to define metrics)
3) A rebate/clawback that returns marginal revenue if ramp targets are not met within the agreed windows
4) Executive sponsor on Helios side with a named signatory and a monthly executive sync for the first 6 months

Marcus / Naomi — proceed with the financial terms and the rebate schedule. Legal to produce a draft SOW and I’ll sign the executive concession email once legal confirms the wording.

Vivek Kulkarni
